name: qlrisk_price_fx_forward
title: Price a FXForward
description: Price one qlrisk FXForward (FX Forward - agreement to exchange currencies at future date; fx, fx): NPV in the trade currency and the reporting currency, pricing components, analytic Greeks where the pricer gives them, and optional cash flows. Inputs are this product's fields only; required: settlement_date, base_currency, quote_currency, base_notional, forward_rate. Market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today; override curves, spots and vols, or apply shocks, with market_data as in qlrisk_price_trades. For a book of several products use qlrisk_price_trades. Example: {"settlement_date": "2027-10-11", "base_currency": "EUR", "quote_currency": "USD", "base_notional": 1000000, "forward_rate": 1.1}.
